contea di ritrovamento: Isle of Wight (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete Roman or Early-Medieval (Anglo-Saxon) unidentified object (c. AD 200-c. 450). The object was possibly double-looped when complete and is broadly flat on both faces. The outside loop is rectangular and portions of the other loop curve inwards. The upper face has inscribed decoration. There is a ring-and-dot motif at each end of the rectangular loop.
